==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a party. I am wearing a purple top hat, red sunglasses, and an outfit made of fur. I am dancing in the flashing lights.

The fur might not be an outfit. I might be some kind of sasquatch. If so, then no one around me seems to mind.

Maybe they're not quite human either? I can't see anyone else's face. I guess it doesn't matter much either way.
